mapper.select: SELECT aftersale_no,phase,status,attempts,claim_version,last_error,updated_at FROM aftersale_task WHERE status='MANUAL_REVIEW' ORDER BY updated_at,aftersale_no LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aftersale_task WHERE status='MANUAL_REVIEW'
SELECT * FROM platform_dispute WHERE dispute_no=#{no} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_dispute(dispute_no,aftersale_no,user_id,idempotency_key,request_hash,reason) VALUES(#{no},#{aftersaleNo},#{userId},#{key},#{hash},#{reason}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE dispute_no=dispute_no
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM platform_dispute WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM platform_dispute user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,dispute_no DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_dispute SET status='DECIDED',decision=#{decision},decision_reason=#{reason},decided_by=#{actor},version=version+1,decided_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE dispute_no=#{no} AND version=#{version} AND status='OPEN'

UPDATE aftersale SET status=IF(type='RETURN_REFUND','WAITING_RETURN','REFUND_PROCESSING'),return_deadline=IF(type='RETURN_REFUND',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)+INTERVAL 7 DAY,return_deadline) WHERE aftersale_no=#{no} AND status='PENDING_REVIEW'
UPDATE aftersale SET status='REJECTING' WHERE aftersale_no=#{no} AND status='PENDING_REVIEW'
